_description: The gate discipline as data. scripts/trace-report.mjs reads this instead of hardcoding stage names; the analyser names no stage. Editing THIS file is how the discipline changes. Docs: .cursor/brain/VERIFICATION.md.
_phaseMeaning: The web siblings gate a scaffold phase that skips build/e2e until the first deploy. MEASURED here 2026-08-30: the whole gate is 8.7s (coverage 4.2 · lint 2.1 · tsc 1.2 · format 0.5 · oxlint 0.4 · script tests 0.2 · hooks 0.05) — there is no build, no e2e and no size stage to skip, so a phase switch would be machinery gating nothing. Recorded as a decision, not an omission; revisit if a native build or a Maestro run ever enters the gate.

verify.description: hooks -> oxlint -> format -> tsc -> eslint -> script tests -> coverage

commit.description: Husky pre-commit: staged autofix, TDD sibling gate, repo-wide checks. Those run as direct commands, not traced npm scripts, so this moment is declared for completeness.

push.description: Husky pre-push -> verify:ci. Runs unconditionally, never shortened by what the diff touched.
